dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal Conjecture: r(K^(3)_4, S^(3)_n) and gr(G_{2x2}, K_n) have the same order
dossier_meta.statement_text: We strongly believe that $r(K^{(3)}_4, S^{(3)}_n)$ and $\mathrm{gr}(G_{2\times 2}, K_n)$ are of roughly the same order.
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper shows $r(K^{(3)}_4, S^{(3)}_n) \le 2^{\mathrm{gr}(G_{2\times 2},K_n)}$, and the authors construct lower bounds for $r(K^{(3)}_4, S^{(3)}_n)$ by gluing together lower-bound constructions for $\mathrm{gr}(G_{2\times 2}, K_n)$, yielding comparable sizes. No direct implication between the lower bounds is known.
